original_benchmark.notes: 20 ML research tasks on public HuggingFace datasets, each scored by the task's evaluate.py and normalized against literature SOTA. No reference solutions are released. License CC BY-NC 4.0.

harbor_adapter.notes: All 20 upstream rad/ tasks adapted. Oracle submits gold test labels. Reward is the paper's normalized score clipped to [0, 1]. Parity not run yet; Kaggle web traffic, rideshare and APPS oracles not yet verified locally.
